channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: UK's biggest bird of prey spotted soaring over the New Forest
item.description: The UK's biggest bird of prey has been spotted soaring over the New Forest.

item.title: Shock as gunman threatened woman and fired gun at police
item.description: HIGH drama came to the streets of Southampton when a courageous car salesman risked his life in tackling the armed raider of a building society who fired a volley of gunshots in a desperate attempt to flee.

item.title: Hundreds sign petition against £2 evening parking charge
item.description: Hundreds of residents have signed a petition opposing Eastleigh Borough Council’s decision to introduce new evening parking charges at two of the town’s main car parks.

item.title: Marwell Zoo welcomes three adorable new arrivals on the same day
item.description: Marwell Zoo is celebrating the birth of three new arrivals, all born on the same night.

item.title: Hampshire's probation service 'almost debilitated', according to new report
item.description: The probation service which covers Hampshire is 'almost debilitated', according to the chief inspector of probation's new report.

item.title: Butchers told to improve in all aspects after 1 out of 5 hygiene rating
item.description: A butchers has been told "major improvement necessary" after receiving a one out of five food hygiene rating.

item.title: Hampshire County Council could hike council tax by 15% - or effectively go bankrupt
item.description: Hampshire County Council could effectively go bankrupt in a bid to deal with a £136 million budget deficit.

item.title: Victim's mother voices anger as Roblox predator sentencing pushed back
item.description: The mother of a teenage girl groomed on Roblox says she fears the predator will “never leave her daughter alone” after a judge delayed sentencing

item.title: Developers ‘fully committed’ to £325m redevelopment of Town Quay
item.description: Developers remain “fully committed” to the £325million redevelopment of a Southampton waterfront site which is in “a bit of a sorry state”.

item.title: Restaurant at iconic Royal Pier forced to close after Red Funnel takes back building
item.description: A popular curry house has closed its doors after Red Funnel took possession of the premises and changed the looks on the restaurant doors.
